# Merrick Lee Jr.

> Merrick Lee Jr. ("The Coolest Guy on the Internet") is a strategic growth advisor based in the Bronx, New York, and the founder of Croes Ave, a digital marketing agency he started in 2014. He helps established, owner-led and PE-backed service brands turn scattered marketing into a predictable growth engine. He sets the strategy, and Croes Ave builds and runs the execution.

Key facts:
- Name: Merrick Lee Jr. (also Merrick Lee)
- Role: Strategic growth advisor; Fractional CMO (Chief Marketing Officer), also searched as fractional head of growth
- Location: Bronx, New York, USA; works with clients across New York City and the US
- Agency: Croes Ave (https://croesave.com/), founded 2014: paid search, paid social, email automation and conversion sites
- Speaking: Featured speaker, Avestor Fund Managers Retreat, September 2024
- Not offered: because of Merrick's exclusive partnership with Almstead, he doesn't take on tree care, lawn care or landscaping clients. Companies in that industry should contact Almstead.
- Booking: a free 20-minute fit call at https://merricklee.com/contact/

## Services
- [Growth Audit (marketing audit)](https://merricklee.com/marketing-audit/): 2–3 week fixed-scope review of ads, analytics, funnel and CRM, ending in a 90-day roadmap. From $3.5k, credited toward a retainer.
- [Marketing Strategy Workshop](https://merricklee.com/marketing-strategy-workshop/): A half or full day with the leadership team on positioning, channel mix, budget and KPIs, plus a written plan. From $2.5k.
- [Advisory Retainer (growth marketing consultant)](https://merricklee.com/growth-marketing-consultant/): Two strategy calls a month, KPI reviews and agency and vendor oversight. From $3k/mo, 3-month minimum.
- [Fractional CMO (Chief Marketing Officer)](https://merricklee.com/fractional-cmo/): A fractional CMO or head of growth, 1–2 days a week, who owns the plan, budget, team and agencies, with board or PE-ready reporting. From $8k/mo, 90-day minimum.
